newsitem.title: USA: Federal-Mogul Australia unit sale done.
newsitem.headline: Federal-Mogul Australia unit sale done.

text.p: Federal-Mogul Corp said Tuesday it completed the sale of its Australian aftermarket operations to Automotive Components Ltd, a private company incorporated in Victoria, Australia.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed. However, Federal-Mogul said it will maintain supply agreements with ACL for the Australian and New Zealand replacement markets.

"We are very pleased to be selling this operation to ACL as they are highly focused on growing the Australian aftermarket operations," Dick Snell, chairman of Federal-Mogul, said in a statement. "This is our first divestiture to include retail stores and we are on schedule with our restructuring plan to divest the international retail stores and selected wholesale operations in 1997."
Federal-Mogul makes a broad range of non-discretionary parts primarily for automobiles, light trucks, heavy trucks, and farm and construction vehicles.
